summary: The source builds n=floor(dim²/sparsity) CSR entries. It selects a standard one-thread-per-row kernel unless max row length exceeds 64, in which case it uses a cooperative one-block-per-row kernel. The standard kernel visits the full row interval; the cooperative kernel distributes rowLen entries over blockDim.x strides, reduces shared partial sums, and thread 0 stores. The timed host loop dispatches the selected kernel once per requested iteration; the first loop launch is not separately dropped, and synchronization ends timing. Compiled main's branch calls and both launch stubs through cudaLaunchKernel were traced; both native sm86 SASS bodies were inspected through arithmetic loops/backedges and output stores.
